title: HRT discussion documentation

user_facing_items.final_wording: Lists menstrual-cycle changes, vasomotor, genitourinary, mood, musculoskeletal, and sexual symptoms and their variable severity and duration.
user_facing_items.population: Women, trans men, and non-binary people registered female at birth with menopause-associated symptoms.
restrictions: Exact for menopause symptom identification, selected test limitations, shared discussion, and review; international and partial for UAE prescribing and local referral practice.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Defines symptom-and-cycle-based identification in people aged 45 or over and limits laboratory and imaging tests, including FSH in specified contexts.

user_facing_items.rationale: Preserves age, cycle and contraception qualifiers.
